validatedOpinion.uncertaintyNotes: The one near-threshold item is 'sparking an unexpected struggle' in description. The overview links the two only by simultaneity ('While investigating... tries to change his ways'), so 'sparking' turns that into a cause, and 'unexpected' is an unstated characterization. I read the phrase as narrative framing of the stated premise that names no event or outcome, so I kept it within tolerance. A stricter adjudicator could ask for 'sparking an unexpected struggle' to be softened toward the source's own 'while... tries to change his ways', in which case it would be a MINOR causal concretization. The curiosityHook's 'before his spiral swallows him whole' implies a downfall is possible, but it is posed as a question and names no outcome.
